designationHistory.indexText: Bear Butte became a limited-interest (easement) refuge, built on easements from private landowners, the state of South Dakota and the War Department; the Fish and Wildlife Service cites an executive order of August 26, 1935 for its purpose.

authority.citation: Easement acquisition; refuge purpose cites an Executive Order of August 26, 1935

designationHistory.note: FWS only. The CCP gives 'late 1930s' for the easements but quotes an 'Executive Order, August 26, 1935' for the purpose; that order was not found in the American Presidency Project. Wikipedia gives August 26, 1935 (lead only). The date recorded is the order date the CCP quotes, not a confirmed establishment date.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Comprehensive Conservation Plan: Bear Butte National Wildlife Refuge, 2007 (ServCat 1388)
